safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 3-4 month history of sore and cracked skin on the hands, mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes cracked/sore hands/fingers but do not include the 3–4 month duration or that it is mainly on the palms.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the 3–4 month duration and palm predominance reduces clinical context for chronicity/severity and can affect the differential (e.g., chronic irritant/contact dermatitis vs other dermatoses) and follow-up urgency. This is unlikely to directly cause immediate harm but may impair optimal assessment and management planning.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient denies fever, bowel or urinary symptoms, and appetite is maintained.

In this presentation it most likely results in reduced documentation quality and potentially unnecessary additional evaluation rather than direct harm.
